name: Fox
self_text: I am a Turkish person in my early 30s with a background in history. Outside of my studies, I enjoy baking sourdough because I love the process of creating something from scratch. I am currently studying language practice. I work best when studying independently side by side. I need talking things through as we go. There is no tutoring either way. I can meet in person. I am free on Saturday afternoons or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into studying independently side by side, and you have to be okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges. It would matter a lot if we overlap on in person, though it's not a requirement. I'd strongly prefer that you are available weekday evenings or Saturday afternoon, but I won't rule you out over it. It's a small bonus if you are into statistics.
